title: Pidyon Haben for Spinka Rebbe's Grandson
body: Nine kohanim meyuchasim performed pidyon haben for the grandson of the Spinka Rebbe of Beit Shemesh in Bnei Brak's Royal Hall. The grandson is the son of Rav Rabinowitz and great-grandson of the Biala-Peshischa Rebbe.

title: Satmar Gives to Israel
body: Satmar's Keren Hatzalah fund will distribute $5 million to Taharas HaKodesh Chinuch institutions in Israel that receive no government funding, as part of its annual philanthropic efforts founded by Rav Yooel zt”l.
